metric_definitions.active_runtime_s: sum of per-command execution times (the cross-runner comparison metric; excludes human-approval wait)
metric_definitions.elapsed_wallclock_s: task calendar span incl. overnight human-approval gap
metric_definitions.note: LOMO ran 4 workers in parallel, so its command-time SUM (21573 s) is larger than its wall-clock (~1.5 h); active_runtime_s therefore counts total compute work, and active_runtime_s <= elapsed_wallclock_s holds against the calendar span.
